title: Model Market Pulse: pricing elasticity experiments and substitution risk simulator
creator: Miguel Ortega
description: Goal: build a repeatable, lightweight framework and dashboard that measures market pricing elasticity across popular open models and simulates customer substitution risk under price / availability shocks. Scope: gather pricing & latency data, surface per-model availability trends (region & capacity-tier), run small randomized pricing experiments with beta customers, and produce a substitution-risk simulator that maps likely migration vectors and cost delta for customers. Deliverables: (1) model-market pulse dashboard (time-series + cohort views), (2) experimental results and elasticity coefficients by use-case bucket, (3) substitution-risk simulator prototype (spreadsheet + UI mocks), (4) recommended commercial playbook (pricing triggers, reserved-capacity offers).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows historical price and median latency for top 12 tracked models across us-west, eu-central, asia-southeast for last 90 days
Elasticity experiments completed with at least 3 beta customers and documented effect sizes per use-case bucket
Substitution-risk simulator can produce a ranked list of top 3 replacement model choices and estimated monthly cost delta given inputs: tokens/month, latency SLO, region
Product playbook draft with recommended triggers for sales/CS and two option templates for committed capacity offers
tasks: Instrument pricing and latency scrape + storage schema (ENG dependency)
Define use-case buckets and sampling plan for elasticity tests (PM + Research)
Recruit 3 beta customers and legal sign-off for experiment terms
Prototype simulator as Google Sheet and validate against historical churn events
Design dashboard mocks and data contract with Analytics team
Write PRD and circulate for exec review
